desktop_launch_surface.claim: Launch the Codex desktop app or installer
desktop_launch_surface.risk: launches official desktop host surface; not an isolation proof

app_server_surface.risk: capable standalone app-server surface exists, but previous GUI child did not expose an isolated control socket under the tested CODEX_HOME

app_server_daemon_surface.risk: daemon start/restart/remote-control are mutating and outside this forensic contour

app_server_proxy_surface.risk: useful only if a valid GUI-child or daemon socket is machine-observed

remote_control_surface.risk: mutating daemon control surface; should be tested only in an isolated future contour

debug_app_server_surface.risk: not sufficient unless the target socket/process is tied to the already-launched GUI child
